onscreen_lines.desc: Related materials commonly sold by the Independent Contractor to its customers and that are necessary or recommended for use in conjunction with the services offered by the Independent Contractor are also included in this solicitation, in accordance with the requirements and/or restrictions referenced within this RFP. Products directly related to contracted services can include but are not limited to the following items with the District: 1. Books 2. Training Materials 3. Teaching Materials 4. Software Programs/ Licenses 5. Educational Kits 6. Evaluation Materials 7. Examinations/ Testing Materials 8. Instruments Related materials falling in this category include materials in hard copy or digital format, materials copyrighted or otherwise protected by intellectual property rights held by the Independent Contractor or a third party but which the Independent Contractor is an authorized re-seller/distributor for, and/or software or software licensing for a software/system (either developed by the Independent Contractor or by a third party for which the Independent Contractor is an authorized re-seller/distributor/licensor for) which are produced, distributed, and/or sold by the Independent Contractor in direct support of the services offered. However, such materials may not be sold or purchased by the District if the materials are not acquired in direct support of, and/or in conjunction with, the services being provided by the Independent Contractor or if it is determined, in Houston ISD's sole discretion, that the materials can be procured by the District under more favorable conditions through another existing District contract, through a purchasing cooperative, or through a separate competitive procurement process. onscreen_lines.desc: MARKET BASKET 1 - Leadership Development Staff/Professional Development - Staff/Professional development for instructional leadership staff, inclusive of campus-based administrators, e.g. principals, assistant principals, deans, instructional school leaders, school support officers and school chiefs in various areas including, but not limited to the following: A. Visionary thinking and planning B. Data driven leadership/instruction C. Culture developer D. Leadership team’s manager E. Instructional planning F. Giving and receiving feedback G. Coaching and mentoring H. Reducing the achievement gap I. Instructional development for teachers J. Recruitment and retention of highly effective staff K. Lowering the dropout rate L. Meaningful parent engagement M. Community engagement N. Student progress and achievement O. Ethical leadership P. Business management Q. Marketing R. Evaluating and coaching staff S. Digital leadership strategies that enhance instructional leadership T. Digital tools for supervising instruction or creating an innovative digital school culture U. Establishing collaborative communities V. Improving facilitation skills, leading effective meetings, using protocols effectively W. Diversity X. Social and emotional competencies that positively impact school/classroom climate and culture Y. Instructional strategies designed to prioritize standards, engage learners and create a culture of high expectations to improve student achievement Z. Instructional rounds AA. onscreen_lines.desc: MARKET BASKET 6 - Social-Emotional Learning 1. Staff/Professional Development – professional development for leaders, teachers and staff in areas including, but not limited to, classroom management, implicit bias understanding, restorative practices (RP), and trauma and grief responsiveness 2. Implicit Bias training which includes facilitation and delivery of professional development that teaches the impact of bias in education and the decision-making process. A. Addresses racial disproportionality in exclusionary discipline B. Addresses individual differences including race, disability, LGBTQ, language, religion, U.S. citizenship status, nation of origin, and gender C. Promotes self-awareness in educators D. Describes actionable district and campus interventions to reduce implicit bias 3. Restorative Practices (RP) training which includes facilitation and delivery of professional development that teaches conflict resolution and assists in impacting a culture that promotes positive behavior. A. Promotes whole class positive behavior B. Teaches conflict resolution strategies as an alternative to exclusionary discipline C. Promotes prevention and de-escalation D. Focuses on historic racial disproportionality in exclusionary discipline E. Addresses a full continuum of Restorative practices from prevention to circles to thinkeries. 4. Trauma and Grief training which includes facilitation and delivery of professional development that teaches the school-based clinicians’ trauma and grief assessment and intervention. A. Addresses impact of trauma and grief in exclusionary discipline. B. Teachers an objective method to identify best candidates for trauma and grief intervention. C. Promotes a mental-health continuum. D. Describes actionable district and campus interventions to address trauma and grief in schools.
